category_title: Students with learning difficulties and attention issues who reset tasks when challenged
scenario_title: Mental math practice on Nintendo DS
minimal_context: The student is practicing single-digit addition, subtraction, and multiplication sums in the x20 game on a Nintendo DS.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the x20 game on the Nintendo DS and start solving the addition and subtraction sums.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the screen and appears bored) I can read the sums, but I don't know how to do these calculations.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to answer the next one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the screen, easily distracted) This sum is getting too challenging. If I don't get it right, I won't get the highest score.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the answer might be?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches for the console and resets the Nintendo DS) It's too hard to complete. I'm restarting the game because I'm not going to do well on this one.
